title: sizeInBytes in ShuffleQueryStage node in Spark Query plan
question:
What is sizeInBytes in ShuffleQueryStage node in a Spark execution plan?

I have a stage to read from ext. source with Shuffle Write = 1.8 TiB

AQE ShuffleQueryStage sizeInBytes shows 7.4 TiB And the next stage (where join happens) shows Spill(memory) = 7.3 TiB and Spill(disk) = 1.7 TiB on sorting

Cached size with MEMORY_ONLY= 4.6 TiB

Could sizeInBytes be the size of the object in memory before it is shuffled?
answer:
As per my understanding,

  • Shuffle Write (size) is the compressed (, serialized) value of sizeInBytes.

So, yes, your assumption is correct on sizeInBytes.
